verdict.rationale: Evidence strongly covers prepaid/debit-style program building blocks — card products, users, businesses (for commercial/parent-child account structures), JIT funding, velocity/authorization controls — supporting multi-purpose card programs, but no doc explicitly mentions commercial credit or consumer credit card programs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of credit card program support (commercial credit, consumer credit), credit-specific APIs (e.g., billing, interest, statements) or case studies confirming credit issuance.
